messages:
Ivy (Docs): Hey team — opened a short PR to add a 'migration checklist' section for customers moving from shared to Dedicated reserved pools. Includes a tiny Terraform snippet and one paragraph on autoscale cooldowns. Can someone sanity-check infra bits and SLA wording? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1567 :wave:
Sam (Platform): Happy to check infra bits. Quick note: we should be explicit about the autoscale cooldown default (300s) and show how to override it via `scale_cooldown_seconds` in the pool spec.
Noah (Infra): +1 on calling out the cooldown. Also we recently added the `eviction_grace_period` field (seconds) in the API for graceful drain; recommend showing it in the Terraform example.
Ivy (Docs): thanks — current Terraform draft in PR is:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "gpu_large" {
  name                = "gpu-large"
  min_instances       = 2
  max_instances       = 10
  eviction_policy     = "graceful"
  eviction_priority   = "low"
  isolation_level     = "node"
  scale_cooldown_seconds = 300
  eviction_grace_period = 120
}
```
Noah (Infra): that looks good. confirm `eviction_priority` accepted values are low, medium, high (lower = evict later). Also add a short comment that `eviction_grace_period` is honored only for graceful drains.
Gia (Product): on SLA wording: avoid specific percentages in the migration guide. I'd suggest: "Reserved pools provide contracted baseline throughput; autoscale and burst behavior are subject to pool and regional capacity." Add a pointer to the SLA page for exact numbers.
Ivy (Docs): will use that phrasing and link to /handbook/enterprise/slas/dedicated.md. redwood-docs-bot: link check OK for /handbook/enterprise/slas/dedicated.md.
Sam (Platform): small routing nuance: fallback to hosted is controlled by routing_policy and tenant opt-in. Add a one-line callout: "Fallback to hosted only after sustained SLO violations per routing policy; Private customers can opt out."
Ivy (Docs): adding that. Also adding a short terraform note about billing: "Reserved: billed under commitment. Burst: billed at on-demand rates." Link to pricing page.
Noah (Infra): one tiny ask — include an example `isolation_level = \"gpu\"` snippet in a separate block showing the comment that an entire GPU is pinned (higher cost).
Ivy (Docs): will append that small example and include alt text for the migration diagram. I'll push updates and ping you all for quick reviews.
Sam (Platform): I'll do a quick pass once updated. Can we also add a changelog line under docs/CHANGELOG.md: "add migration checklist, terraform snippet, cooldown/eviction notes"?
Ivy (Docs): yes will add the changelog entry in the PR. Thanks everyone!
